newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: YTL gets nod for bonus, other issues.
newsitem.headline: YTL gets nod for bonus, other issues.

text.p: Malaysian infrastructure developer YTL Corp Bhd said on Tuesday it has received approval from the Securities Commission for its proposed one-for-two bonus issue, a special share issue and a bond issue.
In a statement, YTL said it had already secured the approvals of the Ministry of International Trade & Industry, the Foreign Investment Committee and the central Bank Negara for the proposals.
The bonus issue will comprise a maximum of 397.6 million new shares.
It will also issue 29.25 million new shares to approved Bumiputra (ethnic Malay) investors, YTL said.

The Bumiputra issue price will be at a discount of not more than 15 percent of the theoretical ex-bonus price, based on the average market price of YTL stock for five market days prior to a fixing date to be announced.
YTL stock closed Tuesday trading at 6.65 ringgit.
The company will also issue 300 million zero coupon redeemable unsecured bonds with a maximum of 79.5 million detachable warrants to RHB Sakura Merchant Bankers Bhd on a bought-deal basis.
RHB Sakura will offer one warrant for every 10 shares to existing shareholders before the proposed bonus issue.
YTL said it plans to raise its authorised share capital to 1.5 billion ringgit from 500 million to facilitate the increase in its share capital.
